projects.name: Jupiter Medical Center Neighborhood Hospital at Avenir
projects.description: 53,370 SF neighborhood hospital with 29 beds, 4 ORs, and 24-hour ED plus 47,000 SF three-story MOB at Avenir master-planned community. Early 2028 opening.

sources.title: Jupiter Medical Center Avenir groundbreaking, Town-Crier
Jupiter Medical MOB and hospital, MCD Magazine

projects.open_for: Ground broken. Hospital MEP and medical equipment specs active.

projects.name: Exalt Health Inpatient Rehabilitation Hospital Riverview
projects.description: 39,093 SF 40-bed inpatient rehabilitation hospital near BayCare St. Joseph's South Hospital. Late summer 2027 opening; Ryan JV partner and GC. Healthcare development by Ryan Companies in Brandon as part of expanding Tampa Bay healthcare portfolio alongside Riverview rehab hospital.

sources.title: Exalt Health Riverview rehab hospital, Florida Construction News

projects.open_for: Active healthcare build. MEP and rehab equipment specs. Healthcare build. MOB fit-out and MEP specs.

projects.name: Lakeview Corporate Park Tampa
projects.description: 310,000 SF Class A industrial redevelopment at 6700 Lakeview Center Drive converting former 1984 office campus into two rear-load distribution buildings. Q1 2027 completion.
key_specs: Near Port Tampa Bay and I-4/I-75

sources.title: Lakeview Corporate Park Tampa, Florida YIMBY
Richland Capital Lakeview, CRE Market Beat

projects.open_for: Conversion underway. Industrial envelope and MEP specs.

projects.name: Speedway Commerce Center Building III
projects.description: Final phase of 808,693 SF Speedway Commerce Center industrial park. Building III is 217,603 SF with 36-ft clear heights and 32 dock doors; Q4 2026 delivery.

sources.title: Speedway Commerce Center Building III, REBusinessOnline

projects.open_for: Final phase active. Industrial building systems specs.

projects.name: CoreSite Orlando Data Center Expansion
projects.description: Second 76,280 SF two-story data center building at 9701 S John Young Parkway campus. Environmental Resource Permit modification submitted to SFWMD in May 2026.
projects.open_for: Permit submitted. Data center MEP and power specs opening.

projects.name: Palm Beach County Data Center Moratorium
projects.owner: PBA Holdings / WPB Logistics. Palm Beach County
projects.description: 600MW hyperscale AI campus at Central Park Commerce Center denied 5-1 by Palm Beach County Commission July 15 after 12+ hours of testimony. 3.6M SF proposed; denial without prejudice. County commissioners advanced 7-0 proposal for formal moratorium on large-scale data centers following Project Tango debate. First reading scheduled August 27, 2026.
competitor_watch: policy impact on future data center specs
projects.open_for: Denied but may resubmit. Specs on hold pending revised proposal. Regulatory. Monitor for revised data center project specs post-moratorium.

projects.name: Project Swan Lakeland Data Center
projects.description: 600,000 SF data center proposed at 923 Wilkinson Road on 60 acres. Developer withdrew June 3 DRT review after city comments that data centers are not a permitted use; proposal not formally withdrawn.
projects.open_for: Entitlement phase. Specs pending zoning resolution.

projects.name: Stonebridge Fort Meade Hyperscale Data Center
projects.description: 4.4M SF hyperscale data center on 1,300 acres of former phosphate mine land. Development agreement approved April 15; $150M/10-year tax break; lawsuits filed May 14. Groundbreaking targeted end 2026.

sources.title: Polk County data centers, The Ledger

projects.open_for: Pre-groundbreaking. Site prep and power infrastructure specs if lawsuits resolved.

projects.name: Gainesville Fire Station 3 and Southwest Public Safety Center
projects.description: Two public safety groundbreakings in July 2026: 16,773 SF Fire Station #3 ($14M) and 29,754 SF hurricane-hardened Southwest Public Safety Center ($22M) with fire station, Public Works warehouse, and community room.
projects.open_for: Just broke ground. Civic building systems and fire/rescue equipment specs.

projects.name: Logistics Center at Southwest Ranches
projects.description: Class A logistics development on 24 acres at SW 202nd Avenue and Sheridan Street. 300,000+ SF with 36-ft clear heights; construction expected later 2026, completion 2028.

sources.title: Southwest Ranches logistics center, Florida YIMBY

projects.open_for: Site acquired. Pre-construction logistics infrastructure specs.

projects.name: Iron Mountain Miami-Dade Data Center
projects.description: Iron Mountain data center in Miami-Dade County under construction and set to open later in 2026, filed as telecommunications hub with permitted-by-right status.

sources.title: Florida data center activity, Local10 / WLRN

projects.open_for: Near completion. Final MEP and commissioning specs.
